notes: YOUR ACCOUNT IS ACTUALLY YOURS NOW. Fixed a big one: the game was quietly signing you in as a brand new player every single time you launched it, leaving your name, coins, chests and friends behind on an account you could never reach again. The game now remembers who you are. Also fixed: adding an email used to create a SECOND account and abandon everything you had -- it now upgrades the account you already have, same name, same coins, same chests, same friends. Plus a rebuilt first-launch screen with twelve genuinely different portraits, and real text boxes and buttons on the account screen.
